class APIError(QuickbaseError)
    def __init__(self, summary: str, *, status_code: int = 0, method: str = '', path: str = '', message: str | None = None, description: str | None = None, request_id: str | None = None, quickbase_code: int | None = None) -> None
class App(object)
    def apply_schema_changes(self, plan: SchemaPlan) -> SchemaChangeResult
    def code_page(self, name_or_id: str | int) -> 'CodePage'
    def code_pages(self) -> list[CodePageInfo]
    def copy(self, name: str, *, description: str | None = None, keep_data: bool = False, keep_files: bool = False, keep_users: bool = False, assign_token: bool = True) -> 'App'
    def create_role_assignments(self, assignments: Sequence[RoleAssignment]) -> RoleAssignmentResult
    def create_table(self, name: str, *, description: str | None = None, single_record_name: str | None = None, plural_record_name: str | None = None) -> 'Table'
    def delete_role_assignments(self, assignments: Sequence[RoleAssignment]) -> RoleAssignmentResult
    def drop(self, *, confirm: str) -> None
    def ensure_table(self, name: str, *, description: str | None = None, single_record_name: str | None = None, plural_record_name: str | None = None) -> 'Table'
    property id -> str
    def info(self) -> AppInfo
    def member_roles(self, member_id: str | None = None, *, include_groups: bool = True) -> list[MemberRole]
    def members(self) -> list[AppMember]
    def operation(self, name: Literal['describe_schema', 'preview_schema_changes', 'apply_schema_changes', 'list_code_pages', 'read_code_page', 'preview_code_page_change', 'apply_code_page_change'], *, max_changes: int = 20) -> 'AppOperation'
    def preview_schema_changes(self, changes: Sequence[CreateTable | UpdateTable | DeleteTable | CreateField | UpdateField | DeleteField | SetKeyField | CreateRelationship | CreateLookupField | CreateSummaryField | DeleteRelationship]) -> SchemaPlan
    def roles(self, *, refresh: bool = False) -> list[Role]
    def settings_url(self) -> str
    def table(self, name_or_id: str) -> 'Table'
    def tables(self, *, refresh: bool = False) -> list[TableInfo]
    def triggers(self) -> list[AppTrigger]
    def update_role_assignments(self, changes: Sequence[RoleAssignmentUpdate]) -> RoleAssignmentResult
    def url(self) -> str

class BoundPolicy(object)
    def __eq__(self, other: object) -> bool
    def __init__(self) -> None
    def allows(self, verb: Literal['read', 'filter', 'sort', 'insert', 'update', 'delete', 'download', 'delete_file', 'report', 'run_formula', 'create_field', 'update_field', 'delete_field', 'formula', 'lookup', 'summary', 'link', 'unlink', 'update_table', 'delete_table', 'set_key_field', 'create_tables', 'read_code_pages', 'write_code_pages'], table: str, *, field: str | int | None = None, fields: Sequence[str | int] = (), source: tuple[str, str | int] | None = None) -> PolicyDecision
    field app_id: str | None
    property created -> tuple[str, ...]
    def decide(self, request: ReadRequest | WriteRequest) -> PolicyDecision
    def explain(self, verb: Literal['read', 'filter', 'sort', 'insert', 'update', 'delete', 'download', 'delete_file', 'report', 'run_formula', 'create_field', 'update_field', 'delete_field', 'formula', 'lookup', 'summary', 'link', 'unlink', 'update_table', 'delete_table', 'set_key_field', 'create_tables', 'read_code_pages', 'write_code_pages'], table: str, *, field: str | int | None = None, fields: Sequence[str | int] = (), source: tuple[str, str | int] | None = None) -> str
    classmethod def from_json(cls, text: str, *, rules: Sequence[CustomRule] = ()) -> 'BoundPolicy'
    property hash -> str
    def max_records(self, table_id: str) -> int | None
    def offers(self, table: str) -> PolicyOffers[NamedItem]
    def row_limit(self, table_id: str) -> str | None
    def tags_of(self, table_id: str, field_id: int) -> frozenset[str]
    def to_json(self) -> str
